recommendations: Current catalog is small enough, but track it in CI before it grows.
Progressive loading has high upside for this catalog.
Use --max-tokens and --max-tool-tokens to catch schema creep in pull requests.

tools.name: github_search_issues
tools.description: Search GitHub issues across one repository with filters for label, state, author, assignee, updated date, and text query. Returns issue title, number, labels, timestamps, author, assignee, comments count, and URL.

tools.name: create_run
tools.description: Create a benchmark run with provider, model, prompt variant, task id, raw response, token usage, latency, parse verdict, and score.

tools.name: shell_run
tools.description: Run a local shell command. The caller must provide the command, working directory, timeout, and side-effect classification. Commands that mutate files, install dependencies, access secrets, use the network, or delete data require explicit approval.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Capture a structured browser accessibility snapshot with visible text, roles, bounding boxes, input values, clickable elements, console errors, network errors, and current URL. Use this before interacting with a live browser page.

tools.name: github_create_issue
tools.description: Create a GitHub issue. This is a public write action and should only be used after review.
